shah-mosque.datum_basis: Nearest open square eight metres beyond mapped portal: east10..30m,north120m, median1571.897m plus0.103m paving allowance. Estimated local calibration; not a conservation survey or certified absolute elevation. Farther-square raster lows are excluded.

sultan-qaboos-grand-mosque.datum_basis: Clean eastern half of mapped north entry toe: east10..50m,north70/80m returns7.9–8.0m. Adopt8.00m approach plus official1.80m outer-sahn rise. Broadnorth/south median9.08m is biased by southern roof/tree returns and is not the chosen floor. Estimated local calibration; published dome/minaret heights retain the source convention relative to the mosque platform.

hagia-sophia.datum_basis: Estimated basilica floor calibrated to the open west narthex approach: east -95..-75m, north20m gives38.80..38.84m; allow0.16..0.20m threshold/paving. This is not a conservation survey. Roof-contaminated46.29m anchor is rejected for the main church.
hagia-sophia.component_basis: Southern tomb thresholds follow local perimeter samples (1443:40.47..40.91m,1444:41.44..42.04m,1445:41.31..41.82m,1430:41.65..42.24m), rounded upward for paving. East ancillary1452 retains its previous absolute level because its immediate samples47.45..48.36m are inconsistent with lowering to the western approach. Its exact historic threshold remains uncertain. Main masonry support toes35.0m, north perimeter rawminimum36.23m; tomb toes1.5m below their local floors. Circular minaret base supports extend to35.0m absolute at authored radius1.7×shaft radius, and their ownership/cuts use a bounded32-gon enclosing the actualbase.

hassan-ii-mosque.datum_basis: FMH2 published principal floor9.50m NGM and documented sea-level basement structure.
hassan-ii-mosque.support_plan: Basement union includes the mapped architectural footprint and the authored200×100m hall with narrow lower cornice/column allowance, an aligned201.8×102.4m rectangle.
